page: Microsoft Azure EC16es_v6 is an ECEV6 family virtual server configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel processor. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external volumes. It is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing connection to high-performance persistent disks. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance, and no GPU accelerators are present.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the EC16es_v6 is positioned within the memory-optimized tier, offering a dense memory allocation relative to its compute resources. This makes it a qualitatively cost-effective choice for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the need for massive CPU scaling. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks.
